After a car accident

From the Crash to Back on the Trail

  1. The Crash

    Even if you feel okay right now, it is worth getting checked.

  2. The Next 24 to 72 Hours

    Symptoms often show up 24 to 72 hours after a crash. An early evaluation protects your health and gives you a record of your injuries.

  3. Your First Visit

    Come to the yellow door on Baseline Road. Dr. Johnston evaluates your injuries, explains what he finds and documents it.

  4. A Plan You Agree On

    Your goals are heard, and decisions are made together. Care is built around your injuries and works alongside your other providers.

  5. Back to Your Life

    Carrying your grandchildren, hiking your bucket-list trail, competing at a high level. The plan is built around what you want to get back to.

What we treat

Common Injuries After a Car Accident

Whiplash

The most common crash injury. A fast back-and-forth movement strains the muscles and ligaments of the neck.

Neck and Back Pain

Impact forces can irritate the joints of the spine, and the pain can linger without early care.

Herniated Discs

A disc that presses on a nerve can send pain, numbness or tingling into the arms or legs.

Headaches

Headaches that start in the neck are common after rear-end and T-bone collisions.

Soft Tissue Injuries

Sprains, strains and muscle tears often do not show on an X-ray but still affect your day.

Shoulder and Knee Pain

Steering wheel and dashboard impacts can injure joints beyond the spine, so the whole body is checked.

Not sure if your pain is from the accident? Book an evaluation.

Treatments at Coal Creek

Main service

Auto Accident Care

Comprehensive evaluation and treatment of injuries sustained in motor vehicle accidents, including whiplash treatment in Lafayette, neck pain, back injuries, and soft tissue damage. We work directly with insurance companies to simplify your recovery.

Lafayette car accident chiropractic care →

Personal Injury Treatment

Expert chiropractic care for injuries resulting from slip and falls, workplace accidents, and other personal injury scenarios. We provide thorough documentation to support your legal and insurance claims.

Personal injury chiropractor in Lafayette →

Spinal Adjustment

Precise spinal manipulation to restore proper alignment, reduce pain, and improve mobility. Regular adjustments help your body heal naturally and prevent chronic pain from developing after an injury.

Chiropractic adjustments in Lafayette, CO →

Soft Tissue Therapy

Targeted massage, myofascial release, and manual therapy techniques to address muscle tension, scar tissue, and inflammation. Effective for neck, shoulder, and back pain following an accident.

Lafayette soft tissue treatment →

Rehabilitation Exercises

Customized exercise programs designed to rebuild strength, restore range of motion, and prevent re-injury. We guide you through every step so you can continue progress between appointments.

Medical Documentation

Thorough clinical documentation of your injuries, treatment, and progress, critical for insurance claims and personal injury cases. We work alongside your attorney and medical team to support your case.

Dr. Johnston also offers dry needling in Lafayette, CO and a Lafayette TPI screening for golfers and active adults.

Meet the doctor

Dr. Andrew Johnston, D.C.

Doctor of Chiropractic, Certified Chiropractic Sports Physician

A baseball injury in high school sent Dr. Johnston to a chiropractor, and he was back on the field within the week. That is why he became one. He earned his Doctor of Chiropractic at Palmer College of Chiropractic West after a degree in Exercise Science from Brigham Young University.

In his 7+ years in practice he has treated post-traumatic headaches, whiplash, disc herniations and nerve pain after car accidents. He looks for the root cause of the problem instead of chasing symptoms.

Questions

Before Your First Visit

Have a question that is not here? Call the office and ask.

Call (720) 775-2664
I feel fine after my accident. Should I still get checked?
Symptoms often show up 24 to 72 hours after a crash. Even if you feel okay right now, an early evaluation protects both your health and your record of the accident.
Will you work with my doctor and physical therapist?
Yes. Dr. Johnston works alongside your MDs, physical therapists and surgeons so your care fits together.
Do I need a lawyer before I book?
No. You can book a visit on your own. If you have an attorney, records can be shared with them when you ask.
Which insurance do you accept?
We accept auto insurance, MedPay, PIP and personal injury liens, and self-pay is available. Call the office before your visit to ask about your coverage.
Do you offer same-day appointments?
Yes. Same-day appointments are available. Book online or call (720) 775-2664.
What are your office hours?
Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 12 PM and 2 PM to 6 PM. Saturday by appointment. Closed Sunday.
How do I find the office?
The office is the white cottage with the yellow door at 310 W. Baseline Rd. in Lafayette.
